execution: Static script/helper/precondition review and Python AST parse only, with all file tooling require_escalated. No Julia, numerical rerun, host survey, Git ref mutation, source/test edit, integration or push.

findings.finding: The three-step detach/ref-CAS/switch transaction has no exception handler or failure-state record. If the last switch fails, HEAD/worktree remain at detached CAND while master has already moved to BASE. Beforeimages and backup branch prevent data loss, but the script stops without documenting the intermediate state; the exclusive rollback-before directory makes naive rerun fail.
findings.location: rollback-unpromoted.py transaction after switch --detach and update-ref
findings.required_change: Record completed mutation steps and a caught failure snapshot of HEAD/master/backup/index plus exact narrow recovery guidance, or implement guarded recovery that never overwrites intervening user changes. Preserve beforeimages and do not claim success on any partial failure.

findings.finding: All Git metadata subprocess calls, including post-mutation ls-remote checks, have no command deadline. SSH connection timeout/server keepalive alone does not bound a live stalled upload-pack command.
findings.required_change: Bound metadata calls with a wall-clock deadline, preserve timeout/failure evidence, and route post-mutation failures through the failure-state recorder.

positive_evidence: Candidate backup ref and soleparent checks precede mutation; original production rejection required; source/protected/index pins checked; complete src/test candidate equality and clean owned staged paths enforced; exclusive source/index beforeimages written before ref mutations; hooks disabled; master update uses expected-old CAS; no reset-hard or force switch; postchecks cover baseline source tree, protected files, unrelated staged entries/raw diff, untracked membership, diagnostic index and backup blobs. These are good preservation checks but do not resolve the partial-state failure gap.
scope: Rollback-only control review before execution; rejection pending concrete failure-handling fixes
